name: cc-beacon
description: Alerts you when a Claude Code session needs your input or has finished, whether VS Code is focused, in the background or minimized.

ccBeacon.enabled.description: Master switch for CC Beacon alerts.

ccBeacon.port.markdownDescription: Loopback port the hub listens on. `0` means the default: 48812 plus a per-user offset. Changing it asks to update the Claude Code hooks.

ccBeacon.alerts.needsInput.description: Alert when Claude needs approval, has a question, or asks for input.

ccBeacon.alerts.completed.description: Alert when Claude finishes a turn.

ccBeacon.alerts.failed.description: Alert when Claude stops with an error.

enumDescriptions: Only when you can't see the window: another app is in front, VS Code is minimized, another VS Code window is focused, or you've been idle.
Also when you're in this window but looking at something other than the session.
Always, even while you're watching the session.
ccBeacon.osNotifications.when.description: When to show an OS notification instead of an in-window alert.

ccBeacon.inWindowToasts.description: Show an in-window notification when you're in the window but not looking at the session.

ccBeacon.completed.minTurnSeconds.description: While you're in the window, don't alert for turns shorter than this. OS notifications when you're away are not affected.

ccBeacon.sound.volume.description: Volume for in-window alert sounds (0 to 1). OS notification sounds use the system volume.

ccBeacon.sound.needsInput.markdownDescription: Sound for needs-input alerts: a macOS system sound name (`Basso`, `Blow`, `Bottle`, `Frog`, `Funk`, `Glass`, `Hero`, `Morse`, `Ping`, `Pop`, `Purr`, `Sosumi`, `Submarine`, `Tink`) or `none`.

ccBeacon.sound.completed.markdownDescription: Sound for completed alerts. See `#ccBeacon.sound.needsInput#` for names.

ccBeacon.sound.failed.markdownDescription: Sound for failed alerts. See `#ccBeacon.sound.needsInput#` for names.

ccBeacon.preview.includeMessage.description: Show Claude's message text in alerts. Turn off while screen sharing.

ccBeacon.preview.maxChars.description: Maximum length of message text in alerts.

enumDescriptions: Ignore Claude sessions that don't belong to any VS Code window (for example, iTerm).
Send them to the most recently focused VS Code window.
ccBeacon.unmatchedSessions.description: What to do with Claude sessions running outside VS Code.

ccBeacon.diagnostics.includeMessageText.description: Include message text in the Diagnose report. Off by default so reports are safe to share.

walkthroughs.title: Set up CC Beacon
walkthroughs.description: Get alerted when Claude Code needs you or has finished.

steps.title: Connect Claude Code
steps.description:
CC Beacon listens to Claude Code through hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json. You'll see the exact change before anything is written, and a backup is kept.
[Set Up Claude Code Hooks](command:ccBeacon.setupHooks)

steps.title: Allow notifications and send a test
steps.description:
macOS asks once whether CC Beacon may show notifications. Click the test notification when it appears; VS Code then asks once whether CC Beacon may open its link. Tick "Don't ask again".
[Send Test Notification](command:ccBeacon.sendTestNotification)

steps.title: Keep alerts on screen
steps.description:
By default macOS hides notifications after a few seconds. Set CC Beacon's alert style to **Persistent** so a request for approval stays until you see it.
[Open Notification Settings](command:ccBeacon.openNotificationSettings)
